$comment: Change C privacy data contract for Proposal A's iOS overrides script (scripts/apply-ios-project-overrides.js). privacyManifestSourcePath points at the checked-in PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy source owned by Change C; the overrides script copies it into the generated Xcode project. purposeStrings are injected into Info.plist verbatim. Never edit src-tauri/gen/apple directly.

purposeStrings.NSCameraUsageDescription: Plethora uses the camera only when you scan a sync QR code or capture document pages you choose to import. Scanned images stay on this device unless you export or sync them.
purposeStrings.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Plethora uses the microphone only when you record pronunciation practice, dictate a note, or transcribe a lecture. Recordings stay on your device unless you explicitly choose cloud transcription, which is disclosed before first use.
purposeStrings.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Plethora uses on-device speech recognition only when you transcribe an imported file or a lecture you record.
